video.topic: AI changes education from reading textbooks to exploring things on screen. A developer on X built an entire interactive 3D tool of the human anatomy, with accurate models, in a single afternoon. Students stop imagining from a page and start looking; teachers who adopt AI can build interactive applications for their own classes.

transcript.text: Education will no longer be the same due to AI. Now, this guy on X built out an entire 3D interactive tool to be able to explore the entire human anatomy in a single afternoon, full of accurate 3D models. No longer will we have to just look at textbooks and have to imagine things in our head. Now we will be able to look at screens and see how things are built. Teachers who adopt AI will be able to build out interactive applications for all of their students. Now follow for more AI news, videos, and tutorials each and every single day, and catch you in the next one.
